owner_authorization.scope: The current J24B request explicitly authorizes one bounded four-mesh static TET10 torsion campaign; J24 report and contract document the prior Owner authorization for the same model family.

load.type: Saint-Venant terminal traction represented by consistent nodal forces

assumptions: zero warping for a circular shaft
fully fixed x=0 compatible with the exact field
terminal traction matches the Saint-Venant field
limitations: mesh surface is faceted and its represented area/volume differ slightly from the exact cylinder
Saint-Venant reference does not quantify local numerical end effects in the discrete model

observables_and_methods.tip_twist: Least-squares small rigid-rotation fit across mesh nodes satisfying |x-L| <= 1e-10*max(L,1 m): sum(y*uz-z*uy)/sum(y^2+z^2); compare with TL/(GJ). The extraction plane is fixed physically and uses only nodes on x=L.
observables_and_methods.stress: Compare Sxy and Sxz at the TET10 stiffness integration points against -T*z/J and T*y/J at those same physical coordinates. Report volume-weighted L2 error; do not use extrapolated nodal stress as an integration-point value.
observables_and_methods.reactions: Preserve the solver's support reaction entries and global force/moment imbalance; additionally normalize force imbalance by T/R and the X-moment imbalance by T.
observables_and_methods.residual: Record free residual norm, free relative residual and the external-load norm used by the solver normalization.
observables_and_methods.energy: Record external work, secant internal energy and the solver's linear energy identity error; descriptive only.

criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.load_torque_relative_error: 1e-12 is a prospective consistency screen for the discrete nodal torque, which is explicitly normalized to the requested torque; not a mechanics error tolerance.
criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.load_force_resultant_over_T_over_R: 1e-10 is dimensionless using T/R=2000 N; it is a prospective discrete load-balance screen, chosen well above the preflight roundoff-scale residual (~1e-16) while remaining sensitive to a material force imbalance.
criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.free_relative_residual: 1e-8 is retained from the bounded structural campaign indicator; the solver normalizes by max(||f_free||2,1 N). The frozen load is applied only to free terminal DOFs, so the reported full external-load norm is the same norm for this configuration.
criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.reaction_force_closure: 1e-8 uses the same dimensionless force scale T/R and the existing bounded residual-level target; it is prospective for this configuration only.
criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.reaction_x_moment_closure: 1e-8 is dimensionless using the applied torque T and is prospective for this configuration only.
criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.h4_tip_twist_relative_error: 1e-2 is the existing VNV-TET10-STRUCTURAL-CONVERGENCE-012 twist-error acceptance value, retained before this run against the same Saint-Venant circular-shaft solution; the J24B mesh family and supports remain distinct.
criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.h1_to_h4_tip_twist_error_reduction_ratio: 2 is the existing VNV-TET10-STRUCTURAL-CONVERGENCE-012 endpoint error-reduction threshold; it checks only this frozen pair of mesh levels, not monotonic convergence or general TET10 qualification.
criteria_basis_fixed_before_solve.stress_and_energy: No PASS threshold is defined; both remain descriptive due geometry and end-effect sensitivity, and stress is sampled at actual integration points.

criteria_fixed_before_solve.result_route: AnalysisRouter linear-static result must return status PASS; the broader maturity/run_verdict is reported separately.
criteria_fixed_before_solve.integration_point_stress_error: Descriptive only; no stress PASS threshold is claimed.
criteria_fixed_before_solve.energy_identity_error: Descriptive only; no energy PASS threshold is claimed.
criteria_fixed_before_solve.status_rule: Overall PASS only if all four routes return, all per-mesh load/residual/reaction criteria pass, and both h4 twist and h1-to-h4 reduction criteria pass. Any measured criterion violation is FAIL. Missing or unusable required observables are INCONCLUSIVE. This status applies only to this model, source, mesh family and configuration.

execution_scope.checkpoint_policy: Write an atomic start record before each mesh and an atomic completed/failure record after it; retain each level immediately so a later-level failure does not discard earlier levels.
execution_scope.budget_semantics: Wall time, RSS, process count and temporary/archive size are monitored soft limits, not OS-enforced quotas; captured stdout/stderr byte caps are enforced by the launcher.
execution_scope.retry_rule: No retry in this contract. A future attempt needs a separately frozen contract and exact source/diagnostic rationale.

outputs: per-mesh displacement and support reaction checkpoints
controller preflight receipts and attempt ledger
